profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. It is headquartered at Starbase, Texas, and its website is spacex.com.

The company is a for-profit public company that trades under the ticker SPCX and carries SEC CIK 0001181412. It also appears under the name SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A. Its legal exposure is concentrated in Texas, with a count of 126, and no lawsuits are listed against it.

No AI products and no MCP servers are listed for the company.
